intro.text: A listener, one of the twelve who first took warform after it was rediscovered.

items.text: Right after taking warform, Dolimid watched Eshonai use it to face down a rival family that had come to raid their city. Surprised at how forcefully she had spoken, Dolimid asked sarcastically whether she had learned oratory by talking to trees in the wilds; Eshonai answered that she wasn't a hermit, she simply sought freedom.
